products.description:
Ship and operate ML like software — Azure ML pipelines, a model registry, CI/CD, and drift/performance monitoring in production.

Models built in notebooks and copied to prod by hand can't be reproduced, retrained, or trusted. This solution stands up MLOps on Azure Machine Learning: reproducible training pipelines, a versioned model registry, CI/CD for train→register→deploy, managed online/batch endpoints, and monitoring for data drift and model performance — with approval gates before production.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Python, IaC & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Azure ML workspace, compute, and environment management (as code)
  • Reproducible training + evaluation pipelines (Azure ML / MLflow)
  • Model registry with versioning, lineage, and stage promotion
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) train→register→deploy with approvals
  • Managed endpoints + data-drift & performance monitoring with alerts

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An MLOps foundation where every model is reproducible, versioned, approved, and monitored in production — not a notebook copied by hand.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 3 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AIMLOPS-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory of the Azure ML estate before standing up MLOps
    • AIMLOPS-Validate.ps1 — read-only validation + posture report for the Azure ML MLOps loop
    • train_register_pipeline.py — reproducible train -> evaluate -> (gated) register

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
